evidence.snippet: To bridge these gaps, we introduce SkillHarm, a benchmark of skill-based attacks across the skill-use lifecycle, paired with a systematic taxonomy of skill-relevant risks.

claire_radar.motivation: Agent skills occupy a privileged position in the agent workflow, as agents are expected to implicitly follow and execute them, rendering third-party skills a vulnerable attack surface.

source.title: SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing studies evaluate poisoned skills within single task executions and use ad-hoc risk lists. This benchmark systematically covers lifecycle-aware attacks and provides a taxonomy and construction pipeline for reproducible evaluation.
